use_case: Demand forecasting by product family (3 to 12 months) feeding the APS capacity plan, material purchasing, and reserved storm-restoration slots
vendor_or_model: Company data science team; time-series models on the enterprise data platform (Cloud provider B AI services)
data_categories: ERP order history and backlog by customer segment (6 years); federal delivery schedules (FCI); regional hurricane outlooks. No personal data
affects_individuals: No (utilities and other customers, not individuals)
consequential_decision_category: None (influences business decisions; storm-slot allocation affects grid restoration indirectly)
human_in_the_loop: Planners approve every monthly plan; storm slots follow a written minimum-allocation rule; the forecast can add slots but not remove a customer's minimum
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 (FCI stays in the covered enterprise data platform); None binding; NIST AI RMF 1.0 benchmark
safety_or_critical_infrastructure_effect: Indirect: storm-restoration slots offered to utilities
fairness_or_coverage_testing: Signed forecast error by customer segment (investor-owned, municipal, cooperative, federal power, developer); municipal and cooperative under-forecast flagged (R-045)
monitoring: Monthly MAPE by product family and signed error by segment; quarterly report to the committee; retraining under change control

use_case: Predictive maintenance pilot: fault prediction for vapor-phase drying ovens, vacuum oil processing, and winding machines at P2, P4, and P5
vendor_or_model: Company data science team on the enterprise data platform, with OEM failure-mode data
data_categories: About 1,900 historian tags (temperatures, pressures, motor current, vibration) from the read-only historian replicas in the OT DMZs; work order history. Operator ID tags excluded
affects_individuals: No (maintenance staff and operators affected only through equipment safety)
consequential_decision_category: None now; Safety/CI if used to change preventive maintenance intervals (proposal refused)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only; the Maintenance Director's planners decide every action; fixed preventive maintenance schedule unchanged; no write path to historians or controllers
applicable_laws: Company process safety and management-of-change procedures; NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 benchmark (data path); None binding; NIST AI RMF 1.0 benchmark
safety_or_critical_infrastructure_effect: Physical safety if relied on to defer maintenance (R-043)
fairness_or_coverage_testing: Back-test recall by equipment group (vapor-phase versus conventional ovens; vacuum pumps; newer versus older winders); older-winder gap flagged
monitoring: Monthly precision and recall; review of every missed failure; quarterly report to the committee
